info.title: تحليل جذري لمشاكل CN CALL: صوت أحادي، بدء بارد، إشعارات مكررة

parts.text:
حلل مستودع CN CALL الحالي بالكامل كمهندس خبير جدًا في:
Flutter + Android Telecom + WebRTC + LiveKit + FCM + Android AudioManager + Samsung Telecom/InCallUI + Flutter headless engine.

ممنوع تعديل أي ملف.
ممنوع تنفيذ أي إصلاح.
هذه جلسة Root Cause Analysis فقط.

المستودع الحالي:
 /workspaces/cn-call5

المشاكل المؤكدة:

1) One-Way Audio:
عند الاتصال، أحد الطرفين يسمع الطرف الآخر، لكن الاتجاه العكسي لا يصل.
وفي بعض الحالات يحدث العكس حسب أي طرف بدأ المكالمة.

2) Cold Start / Background:
المكالمة لا تنجح بشكل موثوق عندما يكون أحد الطرفين خارج التطبيق أو التطبيق مغلقًا.
بينما عندما يكون التطبيق مفتوحًا عند الطرفين يعمل الاتصال بشكل أفضل.

3) Duplicate notification:
بعد نجاح المكالمة يظهر إشعار CN CALL صغير إضافي أعلى الشاشة، بالإضافة إلى واجهة Samsung Telecom/InCallUI.

المعمارية:

Flutter
Android Telecom Managed ConnectionService
PhoneAccount.CAPABILITY_CALL_PROVIDER
FCM
Flutter headless/background engine
LiveKit
Flutter WebRTC
CallForegroundService
FastAPI backend

الملفات المهمة:

Flutter:
mobile/lib/main.dart
mobile/lib/services/call_session.dart
mobile/lib/services/call_socket.dart
mobile/lib/services/firebase_messaging_service.dart
mobile/lib/services/livekit_call.dart
mobile/lib/services/rtc_call_manager.dart

Android:
mobile/android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/mobile/CallConnectionService.kt
mobile/android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/mobile/TelecomCallActionReceiver.kt
mobile/android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/mobile/TelecomHelper.kt
mobile/android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/mobile/CallForegroundService.kt
mobile/android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/mobile/CallFirebaseService.kt
mobile/android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/mobile/MainActivity.kt

Backend:
server/main.py

LiveKit:
livekit_client 2.11.0

أدلة فعلية من logs:

- LIVEKIT CONNECTED
- LOCAL AUDIO PUBLISHED
- TRACK SUBSCRIBED: TrackType.AUDIO
- REMOTE AUDIO STARTED
- Android Recording active=true
- AudioRecord موجود
- Frames muted=0
- AUDIO_SOURCE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION
- AudioTrack فعلي للمكالمة
- MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION
- connection.setAudioModeIsVoip(true)

لكن لدينا أيضًا دليل مهم جدًا:

في بعض جلسات Android ظهر:
silenced:true
على VOICE_COMMUNICATION

وفي جلسات أخرى ظهر:
silenced:false

وهذا حدث مع جلسات مختلفة وعمليات مختلفة.

كما ظهر:
mModeOwnerPid = 1127
أي Telecom/system هو مالك Audio Mode في بعض الحالات.

وفي بعض اللقطات:
Active communication device = earpiece

وفي لقطات أخرى:
Active communication device = speaker

وظهر أيضًا:
setCommunicationDevice() from com.example.mobile

كما توجد سجلات:
setSpeakerphoneOn(true)
و
setSpeakerphoneOn(false)
من Telecom.

لدينا أيضًا دليل أن LiveKit ينشئ AudioTrack للمكالمة بعد الاشتراك:
AudioTrack usage=USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION
content=CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH

وتوجد جلسات مختلفة للصوت بين العمليات المختلفة.

هناك تجربة سابقة:
LiveKitClient.initialize(
  initialAudioSessionOptions:
    const AudioSessionOptions.communication(),
)

تمت إضافتها إلى main() وtelecomBackgroundMain().
بعدها اختفى الصوت بالكامل وتم التراجع عنها.

لا تقترح إعادة هذا التعديل إلا إذا وجدت دليلًا قويًا جدًا ومباشرًا، وحتى عندها اشرح لماذا.

هناك أيضًا تجربة سابقة ظهر فيها:
FlutterWebRTCPlugin
مُسجل أكثر من مرة مع FlutterEngine.

تحقق هل توجد أكثر من FlutterEngine
أو duplicate plugin registration
أو أكثر من WebRTC/AudioSession owner.

أريد تتبعًا دقيقًا للمسارات.

OUTGOING:

UI
→ Telecom
→ placeCall
→ onCreateOutgoingConnection
→ setDialing
→ ACTION_CALL_OUTGOING
→ Flutter
→ signaling
→ LiveKit
→ microphone publication
→ remote publication
→ remote playback

INCOMING:

FCM / signaling
→ TelecomHelper.addIncomingCall
→ Telecom
→ onCreateIncomingConnection
→ setRinging
→ Samsung InCallUI
→ onAnswer
→ ACTION_CALL_ACCEPT
→ TelecomCallActionReceiver
→ Flutter/headless engine
→ ensureSocketReady
→ call_accept
→ LiveKit
→ microphone + remote audio

حلل بشكل خاص:

A) One-Way Audio
هل المشكلة:
- local publisher؟
- remote subscriber؟
- RTP sender؟
- RTP receiver؟
- track publication؟
- track subscription؟
- remote audio start؟
- audio session؟
- AudioManager routing؟
- Telecom audio mode؟
- microphone silencing؟
- duplicate FlutterEngine؟
- duplicate WebRTC plugin؟
- timing/race بين Telecom وLiveKit؟
- setActive() قبل/بعد LiveKit؟
- FGS timing؟
- headless engine؟

B) Cold Start
قارن بدقة بين:
Foreground FlutterEngine
و
Headless FlutterEngine

وتحقق:
- هل LiveKit يعمل في نفس engine؟
- هل FlutterWebRTCPlugin مسجل؟
- هل initialization يحدث قبل الاتصال؟
- هل socket جاهز؟
- هل FCM launches the correct lifecycle؟
- هل CallForegroundService يبدأ في الوقت الصحيح؟
- هل ConnectionService يبقى حيًا؟
- هل هناك race بين Telecom answer وFlutter initialization وLiveKit connect؟

C) Duplicate Notification
حدد:
- من ينشئ إشعار CN CALL؟
- هل CallForegroundService هو مصدره؟
- هل يوجد إشعار آخر في Flutter؟
- هل FCM يرسل notification payload؟
- هل Telecom نفسه يظهر notification؟
- لماذا يظهر بعد الاتصال وليس فقط عند incoming؟

مهم جدًا:
لا تعتمد على أسماء logs فقط.
تتبع actual code path والـcall graph.
افحص جميع الاستدعاءات وليس أول تطابق فقط.

ابحث عن جميع:
Room(
connect(
setMicrophoneEnabled(
publishTrack
publishAudioTrack
TrackSubscribedEvent
RemoteAudioTrack
AudioTrack
AudioRecord
AudioManager
FlutterEngine
FlutterEngineGroup
GeneratedPluginRegistrant
setActive()
setDialing()
setRinging()
setAudioModeIsVoip()
setCommunicationDevice()
setSpeakerphoneOn()
startForeground()
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_PHONE_CALL
requestAudioFocus
MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION
setMode
mute
setMicrophoneMute

وأيضًا:
- AndroidManifest permissions
- foreground service declarations
- exported components
- Telecom permissions
- PhoneAccount setup
- service launch order
- FCM background handling
- notification payload/data payload
- process lifecycle

أريد مقارنة بين حالتين:

CASE 1:
التطبيق مفتوح عند الطرفين

CASE 2:
طرف واحد داخل التطبيق والطرف الآخر خارج التطبيق/مغلق

حدد EXACTLY ما الذي يتغير في كل case.

لا تعدل الملفات.
لا تنشئ ملفات.
لا تعمل commits.
لا تنفذ shell commands تغير المشروع.

أخرج النتيجة بهذا الترتيب:

1. Architecture discovered
2. Proven facts from current source
3. Proven facts from logs
4. One-Way Audio: strongest root cause
5. One-Way Audio: secondary possibilities
6. Cold Start: strongest root cause
7. Cold Start: secondary possibilities
8. Duplicate notification: strongest root cause
9. Race conditions found
10. FlutterEngine / WebRTC duplication findings
11. Telecom / AudioManager ownership findings
12. Exact file + exact function + approximate line for each root cause
13. ONE diagnostic test for each root cause
14. Expected result of each test
15. Smallest safe fix after confirmation

لا تعطيني قائمة إصلاحات عشوائية.
أريد root cause واحدًا رئيسيًا لكل مشكلة مدعومًا بالأدلة.

1. One-Way Audio
2. Cold Start / Background call failures
3. Duplicate notification

532:     Future<void> showIncomingCall(Map<String, dynamic> call) async {
533:       if (!mounted) return;
534: 
535:       final callId = call['call_id']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
536:       if (callId.isEmpty || await CallSession.instance.isCallEnded(callId)) {
537:         return;
538:       }
539: 
540:       final callerId =
541:           call['caller_id']?.toString() ?? call['from_id']?.toString() ?? '';
542: 
543:       final callerName = call['caller_name']?.toString() ?? 'مستخدم CN CALL';
544: 
545:       if (callerId.isEmpty) return;
546:       if (_incomingCallScreenOpen) return;

548:       _addHistory(name: callerName, id: callerId, incoming: true);

550:       _incomingCallScreenOpen = true;

571: 
572:         try {

574:               await _telecomChannel.invokeMethod<bool>(
575:                 'addIncomingTelecomCall',
576:                 <String, dynamic>{

579:                   'callerName': callerName,
580:                 },
581:               ) ??

585:         }
586: 
587:         if (!telecomShown) {
588:           print(
589:             '[CN CALL][TELECOM] incoming call was not accepted by Telecom',
590:           );
591:         }
592:       }
593:     }
594: 
595:     // المكالمات القادمة مباشرة عبر WebSocket.
596:     rtcManager.onIncomingCall = showIncomingCall;
597: 
598:     rtcManager.onRemoteCallCancelled = (callId) async {
599:       if (_incomingCallScreenCallId != callId) return;

604:     CallSession.instance.incomingCalls.listen(showIncomingCall);

606:     Future.microtask(() async {

609:       if (mounted && pendingCall != null) {

620:   Future<void> _loadLocalData() async {
621:     final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
622: 
623:     // تنظيف بيانات التجارب القديمة مرة واحدة.
624:     const cleanupKey = 'cn_call_real_data_cleanup_v1';
625:     final cleaned = prefs.getBool(cleanupKey) ?? false;
626: 
627:     if (!cleaned) {
628:       await prefs.remove('cn_call_contacts');
629:       await prefs.remove('cn_call_history');
630:       await prefs.setBool(cleanupKey, true);
631:     }
632: 
633:     final contacts = prefs.getStringList('cn_call_contacts') ?? [];
634: 
635:     final loadedContacts = <Map<String, String>>[];
636: 
637:     for (final item in contacts) {
638:       final parts = item.split('|');
639: 
640:       if (parts.length >= 2) {
641:         loadedContacts.add({
642:           'id': parts[0],
643:           'name': parts.sublist(1).join('|'),
644:         });
645:       }
646:     }
647: 
648:     final history = prefs.getStringList('cn_call_history') ?? [];
649: 
650:     final loadedHistory = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
651: 
652:     for (final item in history) {
653:       final parts = item.split('|');
654: 
655:       if (parts.length >= 4) {
656:         loadedHistory.add({
657:           'id': parts[0],
658:           'name': parts[1],
659:           'incoming': parts[2] == '1',
660:           'time': parts.sublist(3).join('|'),
661:         });
662:       }
663:     }
664: 
665:     if (!mounted) return;
666: 
667:     setState(() {
668:       _contacts
669:         ..clear()
670:         ..addAll(loadedContacts);
671: 
672:       _callHistory
673:         ..clear()
674:         ..addAll(loadedHistory);
675: 
676:       _loadingData = false;
677:     });
678:   }

1595: class _CallScreenState extends State<CallScreen> {
1596:   bool muted = false;
1597:   bool speaker = false;
1598:   bool connected = false;
1599:   bool? remoteOnline;
1600:   int seconds = 0;
1601: 
1602:   Timer? _timer;
1603:   bool _closing = false;
1604: 
1605:   @override
1606:   void initState() {
1607:     super.initState();
1608: 
1609:     final manager = RtcCallManager.instance;
1610:     remoteOnline = manager.remoteOnline;
1611: 
1612:     manager.onRemoteAvailabilityChanged = (online) {
1613:       if (!mounted) return;
1614:       setState(() => remoteOnline = online);
1615:     };
1616: 
1617:     manager.onConnected = () {
1618:       if (!mounted) return;
1619: 
1620:       setState(() {
1621:         connected = true;
1622:       });
1623: 
1624:       _startTimer();
1625:     };
1626: 
1627:     manager.onDisconnected = () {
1628:       if (_closing) return;
1629: 
1630:       _closing = true;
1631: 
1632:       if (!mounted) return;
1633: 
1634:       _timer?.cancel();
1635: 
1636:       if (Navigator.of(context).canPop()) {
1637:         Navigator.of(context).pop();
1638:       }
1639:     };
1640: 
1641:     if (manager.inCall) {
1642:       connected = true;
1643:       _startTimer();
1644:     }
1645:   }
1646: 
1647:   void _startTimer() {
1648:     if (_timer != null) return;
1649: 
1650:     _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (_) {
1651:       if (!mounted || !connected) return;
1652: 
1653:       setState(() {
1654:         seconds++;
1655:       });
1656:     });
1657:   }
1658: 
1659:   String get durationText {
1660:     final minutes = seconds ~/ 60;
1661:     final remainingSeconds = seconds % 60;
1662: 
1663:     return '${minutes.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
1664:         '${remainingSeconds.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
1665:   }
1666: 
1667:   Future<void> toggleMute() async {
1668:     final value = !muted;
1669: 
1670:     await RtcCallManager.instance.mute(value);
1671: 
1672:     if (!mounted) return;
1673: 
1674:     setState(() {
1675:       muted = value;
1676:     });
1677:   }
1678: 
1679:   Future<void> toggleSpeaker() async {
1680:     final value = !speaker;
1681: 
1682:     await RtcCallManager.instance.setSpeaker(value);
1683: 
1684:     if (!mounted) return;
1685: 
1686:     setState(() {
1687:       speaker = value;
1688:     });
1689:   }
1690: 
1691:   Future<void> endCall() async {
1692:     if (_closing) return;
1693: 
1694:     _closing = true;
1695: 
1696:     await RtcCallManager.instance.hangup();
1697: 
1698:     if (!mounted) return;
1699: 
1700:     if (Navigator.of(context).canPop()) {
1701:       Navigator.of(context).pop();
1702:     }
1703:   }
1704: 
1705:   @override
1706:   void dispose() {
1707:     _timer?.cancel();
1708: 
1709:     RtcCallManager.instance.onConnected = null;
1710:     RtcCallManager.instance.onDisconnected = null;
1711:     RtcCallManager.instance.onRemoteAvailabilityChanged = null;
1712: 
1713:     super.dispose();
1714:   }

340: # PASSWORD SECURITY
341: # ============================================================
342: 
343: def hash_password(password: str, salt: bytes | None = None):
344:     if salt is None:
345:         salt = os.urandom(16)
346: 
347:     password_hash = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
348:         "sha256",
349:         password.encode("utf-8"),
350:         salt,
351:         200_000,
352:     )
353: 
354:     return (
355:         password_hash.hex(),
356:         salt.hex(),
357:     )
358: 
359: 
360: def verify_password(
361:     password: str,
362:     password_hash: str,
363:     password_salt: str,
364: ):
365:     try:
366:         salt = bytes.fromhex(password_salt)
367:     except ValueError:
368:         return False
369: 
370:     calculated, _ = hash_password(password, salt)
371: 
372:     return hmac.compare_digest(
373:         calculated,
374:         password_hash,
375:     )

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

connections: dict[str, WebSocket] = {}
active_calls: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
active_call_users: dict[str, str] = {}
access_tokens: dict[str, str] = {}
user_access_tokens: dict[str, str] = {}
call_expiry_task: asyncio.Task | None = None


def release_call(call_id: str, reason: str) -> bool:
    record = active_calls.pop(call_id, None)
    if record is None:
        return False

    caller_id = str(record["caller_id"])
    target_id = str(record["target_id"])
    active_call_users.pop(caller_id, None)
    active_call_users.pop(target_id, None)

    status = reason
    if reason == "timeout":
        status = "missed" if record["status"] == "ringing" else "timeout"

    db = get_db()
    db.execute(
        "UPDATE call_records SET status = ? WHERE call_id = ?",
        (status, call_id),
    )
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL] call_id=", call_id, "reason=", reason)
    return True


async def _send_terminal_call_event(
    record: dict[str, object],
    target_id: str,
    message_type: str,
    from_id: str,
):
    """Deliver terminal signaling through the same route as the call.

    A terminal event must not depend on a live WebSocket: an incoming Android
    CallKit UI may be the only process left on the target device.
    """
    call_id = str(record["call_id"])
    payload = {
        "type": message_type,
        "call_id": call_id,
        "target_id": target_id,
        "from_id": from_id,
    }
    target_socket = connections.get(target_id)
    if target_socket is not None:
        try:
            await target_socket.send_json(payload)
            print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL WS]", message_type, "call_id=", call_id, "target=", target_id)
            return
        except Exception as exc:
            print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL WS ERROR]", exc)

    # Only the callee has an incoming native call UI to remove.  FCM is the
    # fallback when that UI exists without a WebSocket (background/terminated).
    if message_type in {"call_cancelled", "call_reject", "hangup", "timeout", "disconnected"}:
        print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL FCM]", message_type, "call_id=", call_id, "target=", target_id)
        send_call_notification(
            target_id=target_id,
            caller_id=str(record["caller_id"]),
            caller_name=str(record.get("caller_name", "مستخدم CN CALL")),
            call_id=call_id,
            message_type=message_type,
        )


async def release_calls_for_user(user_id: str, token: str | None = None):
    call_ids = [
        call_id
        for call_id, record in active_calls.items()
        if user_id in {str(record["caller_id"]), str(record["target_id"])}
        and (
            token is None
            or (
                user_id == str(record["caller_id"])
                and token == record["caller_token"]
            )
            or (
                user_id == str(record["target_id"])
                and token == record["target_token"]
            )
        )
    ]
    for call_id in call_ids:
        record = active_calls.get(call_id)
        if record is None:
            continue
        caller_id = str(record["caller_id"])
        target_id = str(record["target_id"])
        status = str(record["status"])
        peer_id = target_id if user_id == caller_id else caller_id
        message_type = (
            "call_cancelled"
            if user_id == caller_id and status == "ringing"
            else "call_reject" if status == "ringing" else "hangup"
        )
        await _send_terminal_call_event(
            record,
            peer_id,
            message_type,
            user_id,
        )
        release_call(call_id, "cancelled" if message_type == "call_cancelled" else "ended")


async def expire_active_calls():
    now = int(time.time() * 1000)
    expired_ids = {
        call_id
        for call_id, record in active_calls.items()
        if (
            record["status"] == "ringing"
            and int(record["ring_expires_at"]) <= now
        ) or (
            record["status"] == "accepted"
            and record["negotiation_expires_at"] is not None
            and int(record["negotiation_expires_at"]) <= now
        ) or (
            record["status"] == "negotiating"
            and record["connection_expires_at"] is not None
            and int(record["connection_expires_at"]) <= now
        )
    }

    for call_id in expired_ids:
        record = active_calls.get(call_id)
        if record is None:
            continue
        caller_id = str(record["caller_id"])
        target_id = str(record["target_id"])
        if str(record["status"]) == "ringing":
            await _send_terminal_call_event(
                record,
                target_id,
                "call_cancelled",
                caller_id,
            )
        else:
            await _send_terminal_call_event(
                record,
                target_id,
                "hangup",
                caller_id,
            )
            await _send_terminal_call_event(
                record,
                caller_id,
                "hangup",
                target_id,
            )
        release_call(call_id, "timeout")


async def _call_expiry_loop():
    while True:
        try:
            await expire_active_calls()
        except Exception as exc:
            # Never let a transient FCM/WebSocket failure disable expiry for
            # all following calls.
            print("[CN CALL][CALL EXPIRY ERROR]", exc)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)


@app.on_event("startup")
async def start_call_expiry_loop():
    global call_expiry_task
    call_expiry_task = asyncio.create_task(_call_expiry_loop())


@app.on_event("shutdown")
async def stop_call_expiry_loop():
    global call_expiry_task
    if call_expiry_task is not None:
        call_expiry_task.cancel()
        call_expiry_task = None

FCM_TOKENS: dict[str, str] = {}

firebase_key = BASE_DIR / "secrets" / "firebase-service-account.json"
firebase_json = os.getenv("FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON")

if not firebase_admin._apps:
    if firebase_json:
        cred = credentials.Certificate(

        )
        firebase_admin.initialize_app(cred)
    elif firebase_key.exists():

        firebase_admin.initialize_app(cred)

def get_db():

    db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return db


def init_db():
    db = get_db()

    db.execute(
        """

init_db()

# ============================================================
# PASSWORD SECURITY
# ============================================================

def hash_password(password: str, salt: bytes | None = None):
    if salt is None:
        salt = os.urandom(16)

    password_hash = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
        "sha256",
        password.encode("utf-8"),
        salt,
        200_000,
    )

    return (
        password_hash.hex(),
        salt.hex(),
    )


def verify_password(
    password: str,
    password_hash: str,
    password_salt: str,
):
    try:
        salt = bytes.fromhex(password_salt)
    except ValueError:
        return False

    calculated, _ = hash_password(password, salt)

    return hmac.compare_digest(
        calculated,
        password_hash,
    )

def authenticated_user(authorization: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
        return None

    token = authorization[7:].strip()
    return access_tokens.get(token)


def issue_access_token(user_id: str) -> str:
    old_token = user_access_tokens.get(user_id)
    if old_token:
        access_tokens.pop(old_token, None)

    token = uuid.uuid4().hex + uuid.uuid4().hex
    access_tokens[token] = user_id
    user_access_tokens[user_id] = token

    db = get_db()
    db.execute(
        "DELETE FROM access_tokens WHERE user_id = ?",
        (user_id,),
    )
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO access_tokens (token, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
        (token, user_id),
    )
    db.commit()
    db.close()

    return token

def send_call_notification(
    target_id: str,
    caller_id: str,
    caller_name: str,
    call_id: str,
    message_type: str = "incoming_call",
):
    token = FCM_TOKENS.get(target_id)

    print("FCM TARGET:", target_id)
    print("FCM TOKEN FOUND:", bool(token))

    if not token:
        db = get_db()
        row = db.execute(
            "SELECT token FROM fcm_tokens WHERE user_id = ?",
            (target_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        db.close()

        if row:
            token = row["token"]
            FCM_TOKENS[target_id] = token

    if not token:
        return

    if not firebase_admin._apps:
        return

    try:
        message = messaging.Message(
            token=token,
            data={
                "type": message_type,
                "call_id": call_id,
                "caller_id": caller_id,
                "caller_name": caller_name,
                "target_id": target_id,
            },
            android=messaging.AndroidConfig(
                priority="high",
                collapse_key=f"call-{call_id}",
                ttl=timedelta(seconds=95),
            ),
        )

        response = messaging.send(message)
        print('FCM SENT:', response)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FCM send error: {e}")

@app.get("/livekit/token")
def livekit_token(
    user_id: str,
    call_id: str,
    authorization: str = Header(None),
):
    if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="missing token")

    token = authorization.replace("Bearer ", "", 1).strip()

    if access_tokens.get(token) != user_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="invalid session")

    # A token must never create or revive a room for an ended/unknown call.
    # Both endpoints can request their own token only while the server owns
    # this exact active call.
    record = active_calls.get(call_id.strip())
    if (
        record is None
        or user_id not in {str(record["caller_id"]), str(record["target_id"])}
        or str(record["status"]) not in {"accepted", "negotiating", "connected"}
    ):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="unknown_or_ended_call")

    livekit_url = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_URL")
    livekit_key = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_KEY")
    livekit_secret = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_SECRET")

    if not livekit_url or not livekit_key or not livekit_secret:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="livekit not configured")

    room_name = f"call-{call_id}"

    jwt = (
        api.AccessToken(
            livekit_key,
            livekit_secret,
        )
        .with_identity(user_id)
        .with_grants(
            api.VideoGrants(
                room_join=True,
                room=room_name,
            )
        )
    )

    return {
        "success": True,
        "url": livekit_url,
        "token": jwt.to_jwt(),
        "room": room_name,
    }


@app.websocket("/ws/{user_id}")
async def websocket_endpoint(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    user_id: str,
):
    token = websocket.query_params.get("token", "").strip()
    if access_tokens.get(token) != user_id:
        await websocket.accept()
        await websocket.send_json({
            "type": "session_invalid",
            "reason": "invalid_session",
        })
        await websocket.close(code=1008)
        return

    if user_id in connections:
        # Detach the old socket before awaiting close. Its `finally` handler
        # must not see itself as the active connection and release a call that
        # belongs to the replacement WebSocket.
        old_socket = connections.pop(user_id)
        print("[CN CALL][SOCKET REPLACE] user_id=", user_id)
        try:
            await old_socket.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

    await websocket.accept()

    connections[user_id] = websocket
    print("[CN CALL][SOCKET READY] user_id=", user_id)

    try:
        await websocket.send_json({
            "type": "connected",
            "user_id": user_id,
        })

        while True:
            message = await websocket.receive_json()

            # A replacement connection uses the same token. Ignore anything
            # the closing socket manages to receive after it has been detached
            # so it cannot mutate or release the new connection's call.
            if connections.get(user_id) is not websocket:
                await websocket.close()
                return

            if access_tokens.get(token) != user_id:
                await release_calls_for_user(user_id, token)
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "session_invalid",
                    "reason": "session_revoked",
                })
                await websocket.close(code=1008)
                return

            message_type = str(message.get("type", "")).strip()
            call_id = str(message.get("call_id", "")).strip()
            target_id = str(message.get("target_id", "")).strip()
            print("[CN CALL][CALL MESSAGE] type=", message_type, "call_id=", call_id, "from=", user_id)

            await expire_active_calls()

            if message_type == "call":
                if not call_id:
                    call_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

                if not target_id or target_id == user_id:
                    await websocket.send_json({
                        "type": "call_reject",
                        "call_id": call_id,
                        "target_id": user_id,
                        "reason": "self_call_not_allowed",
                    })
                    continue

                db = get_db()
                existing = db.execute(
                    "SELECT status FROM call_records WHERE call_id = ?",
                    (call_id,),
                ).fetchone()
                db.close()
                target_online = target_id in connections

                if existing is not None:
                    await websocket.send_json({
                        "type": "call_reject",
                        "call_id": call_id,
                        "target_id": user_id,
                        "reason": "duplicate_or_busy",
                    })
                    continue

                # Keep the normal busy protection for calls that are
                # actually in progress. However, an offline target may
                # have a stale FCM ringing call. Replace that stale
                # ringing call instead of forcing the caller to wait
                # for the 90-second ring timeout.
                if target_id in active_call_users:
                    previous_call_id = active_call_users.get(target_id)
                    previous_record = (
                        active_calls.get(previous_call_id)
                        if previous_call_id
                        else None
                    )

                    if (
                        previous_record is not None
                        and previous_record.get("status") == "ringing"
                        and target_id not in connections
                    ):
                        send_call_notification(
                            target_id=target_id,
                            caller_id=str(previous_record["caller_id"]),
                            caller_name=str(
                                previous_record.get(
                                    "caller_name",
                                    "مستخدم CN CALL",
                                )
                            ),
                            call_id=str(previous_record["call_id"]),
                            message_type="call_cancelled",
                        )
                        release_call(previous_call_id, "missed")
                    else:
                        await websocket.send_json({
                            "type": "call_reject",
                            "call_id": call_id,
                            "target_id": user_id,
                            "reason": "duplicate_or_busy",
                        })
                        continue

                if user_id in active_call_users:
                    await websocket.send_json({
                        "type": "call_reject",
                        "call_id": call_id,
                        "target_id": user_id,
                        "reason": "duplicate_or_busy",
                    })
                    continue

                ring_expires_at = message.get("ring_expires_at")
                if not ring_expires_at:
                    ring_expires_at = int(time.time() * 1000) + 90000

                created_at = int(time.time() * 1000)
                status = "ringing"
                db = get_db()
                db.execute(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO call_records
                    (call_id, caller_id, target_id, caller_name,
                     created_at, expires_at, status)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    """,
                    (
                        call_id,
                        user_id,
                        target_id,
                        str(message.get("caller_name", "مستخدم CN CALL")),
                        created_at,
                        ring_expires_at,
                        status,
                    ),
                )
                db.commit()
                db.close()

                active_calls[call_id] = {
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "caller_id": user_id,
                    "target_id": target_id,
                    "status": "ringing",
                    "created_at": created_at,
                    "ring_expires_at": ring_expires_at,
                    "negotiation_expires_at": None,
                    "connection_expires_at": None,
                    "caller_token": token,
                    "target_token": user_access_tokens.get(target_id),
                    "media_ready_users": set(),
                }
                active_call_users[user_id] = call_id
                active_call_users[target_id] = call_id

                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "call_started",
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "target_id": target_id,
                    "from_id": user_id,
                    "ring_expires_at": ring_expires_at,
                    "target_online": target_online,
                })

                if target_online:
                    await connections[target_id].send_json({
                        **message,
                        "call_id": call_id,
                        "ring_expires_at": ring_expires_at,
                        "from_id": user_id,
                    })
                else:
                    send_call_notification(
                        target_id=target_id,
                        caller_id=user_id,
                        caller_name=str(
                            message.get("caller_name", "مستخدم CN CALL")
                        ),
                        call_id=call_id,
                    )
                continue

            record = active_calls.get(call_id)
            if record is None:
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "signaling_rejected",
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "message_type": message_type,
                    "reason": "unknown_or_ended_call",
                })
                continue

            caller_id = str(record["caller_id"])
            receiver_id = str(record["target_id"])
            expected_target = receiver_id if user_id == caller_id else caller_id
            sender_role = (
                "caller" if user_id == caller_id else
                "target" if user_id == receiver_id else None
            )
            expected_token = (
                record["caller_token"] if sender_role == "caller" else
                record["target_token"] if sender_role == "target" else None
            )
            if sender_role is None or expected_token != token:
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "signaling_rejected",
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "message_type": message_type,
                    "reason": "sender_not_call_owner",
                })
                continue

            if target_id != expected_target:
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "signaling_rejected",
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "message_type": message_type,
                    "reason": "invalid_target",
                })
                continue

            status = str(record["status"])
            allowed = False
            next_status = status
            terminal = False
            if message_type == "call_accept":
                allowed = sender_role == "target" and status == "ringing"
                next_status = "accepted"
            elif message_type == "call_reject":
                allowed = sender_role == "target" and status == "ringing"
                next_status = "rejected"
                terminal = True
            elif message_type == "call_cancelled":
                allowed = sender_role == "caller" and status == "ringing"
                next_status = "cancelled"
                terminal = True
            elif message_type == "hangup":
                allowed = status in {"ringing", "accepted", "negotiating", "connected"}
                next_status = "ended"
                terminal = True
            elif message_type == "offer":
                allowed = sender_role == "caller" and status in {
                    "accepted", "negotiating", "connected"
                }
                next_status = "negotiating"
            elif message_type == "answer":
                allowed = sender_role == "target" and status in {
                    "accepted", "negotiating", "connected"
                }
                next_status = "negotiating"
            elif message_type == "ice_candidate":
                allowed = status in {"accepted", "negotiating", "connected"}
            elif message_type == "connected":
                allowed = status in {"accepted", "negotiating"}
                next_status = "connected"
            elif message_type == "timeout":
                allowed = status == "ringing"
                next_status = "timeout"
                terminal = True

            if not allowed:
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "signaling_rejected",
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "message_type": message_type,
                    "reason": "invalid_state_or_direction",
                })
                continue

            record["status"] = next_status
            if message_type == "call_accept":
                record["negotiation_expires_at"] = (
                    int(time.time() * 1000) + 30000
                )
                print("[CN CALL][CALL_ACCEPT SERVER] call_id=", call_id)
            elif message_type == "offer":
                record["connection_expires_at"] = (
                    int(time.time() * 1000) + 30000
                )
            elif message_type == "connected":
                record["negotiation_expires_at"] = None
                ready_users = record.setdefault("media_ready_users", set())
                if isinstance(ready_users, set):
                    ready_users.add(user_id)
                    if {caller_id, receiver_id}.issubset(ready_users):
                        record["status"] = "connected"
                        record["connection_expires_at"] = None
                    else:
                        # One endpoint has local media, but the call is not
                        # connected until both have reported a usable path.
                        record["status"] = "negotiating"
            forwarded = {
                **message,
                "call_id": call_id,
                "target_id": expected_target,
                "from_id": user_id,
            }
            if terminal:
                await _send_terminal_call_event(
                    record,
                    expected_target,
                    message_type,
                    user_id,
                )
            elif expected_target in connections:
                try:
                    await connections[expected_target].send_json(forwarded)
                except Exception as exc:
                    print("CALL FORWARD WS ERROR:", exc)

            if terminal:
                release_call(call_id, next_status)

    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass

    finally:
        if connections.get(user_id) is websocket:
            del connections[user_id]
            # A network reconnect is not a call hangup.  Keep ownership and
            # let the call's explicit terminal signal or its expiry timer end
            # it; the next socket for this logical user can safely resume.
            print("[CN CALL][SOCKET CLOSED] user_id=", user_id)

17:  * Telecom framework.
18:  *
19:  * Registered via [InAppCallManager.registerPhoneAccount] with
20:  * [android.telecom.PhoneAccount.CAPABILITY_SELF_MANAGED]. Activated when the
21:  * plugin's incoming-call flow calls `telecomManager.addNewIncomingCall(...)` —
22:  * the OS then invokes [onCreateIncomingConnection] which returns a ringing
23:  * [CallkitConnection]. The Telecom layer grants the resulting call OS-level
24:  * privileges equivalent to a dialer app:
25:  *  - Keyguard bypass on the linked call Activity
26:  *  - Ringtone + vibration via Audio focus
27:  *  - Audio routing (Bluetooth / earpiece / speaker) via AudioManager call mode
28:  *  - Compatibility with strict OEMs (Samsung Knox, Xiaomi, Oppo) that block
29:  *    non-Telecom `showWhenLocked` Activities.
30:  *
31:  * Prior versions of this file were a stub with no overrides — the PhoneAccount
32:  * was registered but never used. Filling in the overrides + wiring
33:  * `addNewIncomingCall` in the BroadcastReceiver converts the plugin from an
34:  * "app that looks like a call" into a real first-party call.
35:  */

1. **One-Way Audio**:

Let me trace through the code paths carefully.

## Architecture Summary

**Flutter Side:**
- `main.dart` - Main entry point with `main()` and `telecomBackgroundMain()` (headless)
- `call_session.dart` - Manages WebSocket connection, session state, incoming call handling
- `call_socket.dart` - WebSocket client
- `livekit_call.dart` - LiveKit room connection, track handling
- `rtc_call_manager.dart` - Call state machine, signaling, LiveKit integration
- `firebase_messaging_service.dart` - FCM handling (both foreground and background)

**Android Side:**
- `CallConnectionService.kt` - Telecom ConnectionService (managed)
- `TelecomHelper.kt` - PhoneAccount registration, addIncomingCall, placeCall

## 4. One-Way Audio: Strongest Root Cause

**Telecom (system) and LiveKit (FlutterWebRTC) own separate audio sessions. Telecom sets `MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION` and controls routing (earpiece/speaker) via `AudioManager`. LiveKit/FlutterWebRTC independently creates an `AudioTrack` with `USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION`. When Telecom acquires audio focus and routes to earpiece, LiveKit's AudioTrack may be silenced (`silenced:true`) because it's not the focus owner. The non-deterministic `silenced:true/false` across sessions is a race: whichever audio session gets focus last wins.**

**File + Function + Line:**  
`mobile/android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/mobile/CallConnectionService.kt:221` — `connection.setAudioModeIsVoip(true)` activates Telecom audio mode WITHOUT requesting audio focus for the LiveKit session.  
`mobile/lib/services/livekit_call.dart:88-114` — `_enableAndVerifyMicrophone()` publishes local audio but never coordinates with Telecom's audio focus/routing.

532:     Future<void> showIncomingCall(Map<String, dynamic> call) async {
533:       if (!mounted) return;
534: 
535:       final callId = call['call_id']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
536:       if (callId.isEmpty || await CallSession.instance.isCallEnded(callId)) {
537:         return;
538:       }
539: 
540:       final callerId =
541:           call['caller_id']?.toString() ?? call['from_id']?.toString() ?? '';
542: 
543:       final callerName = call['caller_name']?.toString() ?? 'مستخدم CN CALL';
544: 
545:       if (callerId.isEmpty) return;
546:       if (_incomingCallScreenOpen) return;
547: 
548:       _addHistory(name: callerName, id: callerId, incoming: true);

620:   Future<void> _loadLocalData() async {
621:     final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
622: 
623:     // تنظيف بيانات التجارب القديمة مرة واحدة.
624:     const cleanupKey = 'cn_call_real_data_cleanup_v1';
625:     final cleaned = prefs.getBool(cleanupKey) ?? false;
626: 
627:     if (!cleaned) {
628:       await prefs.remove('cn_call_contacts');
629:       await prefs.remove('cn_call_history');
630:       await prefs.setBool(cleanupKey, true);
631:     }
632: 
633:     final contacts = prefs.getStringList('cn_call_contacts') ?? [];
634: 
635:     final loadedContacts = <Map<String, String>>[];
636: 
637:     for (final item in contacts) {
638:       final parts = item.split('|');
639: 
640:       if (parts.length >= 2) {
641:         loadedContacts.add({
642:           'id': parts[0],
643:           'name': parts.sublist(1).join('|'),
644:         });
645:       }
646:     }
647: 
648:     final history = prefs.getStringList('cn_call_history') ?? [];
649: 
650:     final loadedHistory = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
651: 
652:     for (final item in history) {
653:       final parts = item.split('|');
654: 
655:       if (parts.length >= 4) {
656:         loadedHistory.add({
657:           'id': parts[0],
658:           'name': parts[1],
659:           'incoming': parts[2] == '1',
660:           'time': parts.sublist(3).join('|'),
661:         });
662:       }
663:     }
664: 
665:     if (!mounted) return;
666: 
667:     setState(() {
668:       _contacts
669:         ..clear()
670:         ..addAll(loadedContacts);
671: 
672:       _callHistory
673:         ..clear()
674:         ..addAll(loadedHistory);
675: 
676:       _loadingData = false;
677:     });
678:   }

78: async def _send_terminal_call_event(
79:     record: dict[str, object],
80:     target_id: str,
81:     message_type: str,
82:     from_id: str,
83: ):
84:     """Deliver terminal signaling through the same route as the call.
85: 
86:     A terminal event must not depend on a live WebSocket: an incoming Android
87:     CallKit UI may be the only process left on the target device.
88:     """
89:     call_id = str(record["call_id"])
90:     payload = {
91:         "type": message_type,
92:         "call_id": call_id,
93:         "target_id": target_id,
94:         "from_id": from_id,
95:     }
96:     target_socket = connections.get(target_id)
97:     if target_socket is not None:
98:         try:
99:             await target_socket.send_json(payload)
100:             print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL WS]", message_type, "call_id=", call_id, "target=", target_id)
101:             return
102:         except Exception as exc:
103:             print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL WS ERROR]", exc)
104: 
105:     # Only the callee has an incoming native call UI to remove.  FCM is the
106:     # fallback when that UI exists without a WebSocket (background/terminated).
107:     if message_type in {"call_cancelled", "call_reject", "hangup", "timeout", "disconnected"}:
108:         print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL FCM]", message_type, "call_id=", call_id, "target=", target_id)
109:         send_call_notification(
110:             target_id=target_id,
111:             caller_id=str(record["caller_id"]),
112:             caller_name=str(record.get("caller_name", "مستخدم CN CALL")),
113:             call_id=call_id,
114:             message_type=message_type,
115:         )

118: async def release_calls_for_user(user_id: str, token: str | None = None):
119:     call_ids = [
120:         call_id
121:         for call_id, record in active_calls.items()
122:         if user_id in {str(record["caller_id"]), str(record["target_id"])}
123:         and (
124:             token is None
125:             or (
126:                 user_id == str(record["caller_id"])
127:                 and token == record["caller_token"]
128:             )
129:             or (
130:                 user_id == str(record["target_id"])
131:                 and token == record["target_token"]
132:             )
133:         )
134:     ]
135:     for call_id in call_ids:
136:         record = active_calls.get(call_id)
137:         if record is None:
138:             continue
139:         caller_id = str(record["caller_id"])
140:         target_id = str(record["target_id"])
141:         status = str(record["status"])
142:         peer_id = target_id if user_id == caller_id else caller_id
143:         message_type = (
144:             "call_cancelled"
145:             if user_id == caller_id and status == "ringing"
146:             else "call_reject" if status == "ringing" else "hangup"
147:         )
148:         await _send_terminal_call_event(
149:             record,
150:             peer_id,
151:             message_type,
152:             user_id,
153:         )
154:         release_call(call_id, "cancelled" if message_type == "call_cancelled" else "ended")

157: async def expire_active_calls():
158:     now = int(time.time() * 1000)
159:     expired_ids = {
160:         call_id
161:         for call_id, record in active_calls.items()
162:         if (
163:             record["status"] == "ringing"
164:             and int(record["ring_expires_at"]) <= now
165:         ) or (
166:             record["status"] == "accepted"
167:             and record["negotiation_expires_at"] is not None
168:             and int(record["negotiation_expires_at"]) <= now
169:         ) or (
170:             record["status"] == "negotiating"
171:             and record["connection_expires_at"] is not None
172:             and int(record["connection_expires_at"]) <= now
173:         )
174:     }
175: 
176:     for call_id in expired_ids:
177:         record = active_calls.get(call_id)
178:         if record is None:
179:             continue
180:         caller_id = str(record["caller_id"])
181:         target_id = str(record["target_id"])
182:         if str(record["status"]) == "ringing":
183:             await _send_terminal_call_event(
184:                 record,
185:                 target_id,
186:                 "call_cancelled",
187:                 caller_id,
188:             )
189:         else:
190:             await _send_terminal_call_event(
191:                 record,
192:                 target_id,
193:                 "hangup",
194:                 caller_id,
195:             )
196:             await _send_terminal_call_event(
197:                 record,
198:                 caller_id,
199:                 "hangup",
200:                 target_id,
201:             )
202:         release_call(call_id, "timeout")
203:

205: async def _call_expiry_loop():
206:     while True:
207:         try:

209:         except Exception as exc:
210:             # Never let a transient FCM/WebSocket failure disable expiry for
211:             # all following calls.
212:             print("[CN CALL][CALL EXPIRY ERROR]", exc)
213:         await asyncio.sleep(1)

340: # PASSWORD SECURITY
341: # ============================================================
342: 
343: def hash_password(password: str, salt: bytes | None = None):
344:     if salt is None:
345:         salt = os.urandom(16)
346: 
347:     password_hash = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
348:         "sha256",
349:         password.encode("utf-8"),
350:         salt,
351:         200_000,
352:     )
353: 
354:     return (
355:         password_hash.hex(),
356:         salt.hex(),
357:     )
358: 
359: 
360: def verify_password(
361:     password: str,
362:     password_hash: str,
363:     password_salt: str,
364: ):
365:     try:
366:         salt = bytes.fromhex(password_salt)
367:     except ValueError:
368:         return False
369: 
370:     calculated, _ = hash_password(password, salt)
371: 
372:     return hmac.compare_digest(
373:         calculated,
374:         password_hash,
375:     )

405: def issue_access_token(user_id: str) -> str:
406:     old_token = user_access_tokens.get(user_id)
407:     if old_token:
408:         access_tokens.pop(old_token, None)
409: 
410:     token = uuid.uuid4().hex + uuid.uuid4().hex
411:     access_tokens[token] = user_id
412:     user_access_tokens[user_id] = token

417:         (user_id,),
418:     )
419:     db.execute(
420:         "INSERT INTO access_tokens (token, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
421:         (token, user_id),
422:     )
423:     db.commit()
424:     db.close()

app = FastAPI(title="CN CALL Server")

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=False,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
VOLUME_DIR = Path("/app/data")
DB_PATH = VOLUME_DIR / "cn_call.db"
LEGACY_DB_PATH = BASE_DIR / "cn_call.db"

VOLUME_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

if not DB_PATH.exists() and LEGACY_DB_PATH.exists():
    shutil.copy2(LEGACY_DB_PATH, DB_PATH)
    print("[CN CALL][DB] Legacy database migrated to Railway Volume")


connections: dict[str, WebSocket] = {}
active_calls: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
active_call_users: dict[str, str] = {}
access_tokens: dict[str, str] = {}
user_access_tokens: dict[str, str] = {}
call_expiry_task: asyncio.Task | None = None


def release_call(call_id: str, reason: str) -> bool:
    record = active_calls.pop(call_id, None)
    if record is None:
        return False

    caller_id = str(record["caller_id"])
    target_id = str(record["target_id"])
    active_call_users.pop(caller_id, None)
    active_call_users.pop(target_id, None)

    status = reason
    if reason == "timeout":
        status = "missed" if record["status"] == "ringing" else "timeout"

    db = get_db()
    db.execute(
        "UPDATE call_records SET status = ? WHERE call_id = ?",
        (status, call_id),
    )
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL] call_id=", call_id, "reason=", reason)
    return True


async def _send_terminal_call_event(
    record: dict[str, object],
    target_id: str,
    message_type: str,
    from_id: str,
):
    """Deliver terminal signaling through the same route as the call.

    A terminal event must not depend on a live WebSocket: an incoming Android
    CallKit UI may be the only process left on the target device.
    """
    call_id = str(record["call_id"])
    payload = {
        "type": message_type,
        "call_id": call_id,
        "target_id": target_id,
        "from_id": from_id,
    }
    target_socket = connections.get(target_id)
    if target_socket is not None:
        try:
            await target_socket.send_json(payload)
            print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL WS]", message_type, "call_id=", call_id, "target=", target_id)
            return
        except Exception as exc:
            print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL WS ERROR]", exc)

    # Only the callee has an incoming native call UI to remove.  FCM is the
    # fallback when that UI exists without a WebSocket (background/terminated).
    if message_type in {"call_cancelled", "call_reject", "hangup", "timeout", "disconnected"}:
        print("[CN CALL][CALL TERMINAL FCM]", message_type, "call_id=", call_id, "target=", target_id)
        send_call_notification(
            target_id=target_id,
            caller_id=str(record["caller_id"]),
            caller_name=str(record.get("caller_name", "مستخدم CN CALL")),
            call_id=call_id,
            message_type=message_type,
        )


async def release_calls_for_user(user_id: str, token: str | None = None):
    call_ids = [
        call_id
        for call_id, record in active_calls.items()
        if user_id in {str(record["caller_id"]), str(record["target_id"])}
        and (
            token is None
            or (
                user_id == str(record["caller_id"])
                and token == record["caller_token"]
            )
            or (
                user_id == str(record["target_id"])
                and token == record["target_token"]
            )
        )
    ]
    for call_id in call_ids:
        record = active_calls.get(call_id)
        if record is None:
            continue
        caller_id = str(record["caller_id"])
        target_id = str(record["target_id"])
        status = str(record["status"])
        peer_id = target_id if user_id == caller_id else caller_id
        message_type = (
            "call_cancelled"
            if user_id == caller_id and status == "ringing"
            else "call_reject" if status == "ringing" else "hangup"
        )
        await _send_terminal_call_event(
            record,
            peer_id,
            message_type,
            user_id,
        )
        release_call(call_id, "cancelled" if message_type == "call_cancelled" else "ended")


async def expire_active_calls():
    now = int(time.time() * 1000)
    expired_ids = {
        call_id
        for call_id, record in active_calls.items()
        if (
            record["status"] == "ringing"
            and int(record["ring_expires_at"]) <= now
        ) or (
            record["status"] == "accepted"
            and record["negotiation_expires_at"] is not None
            and int(record["negotiation_expires_at"]) <= now
        ) or (
            record["status"] == "negotiating"
            and record["connection_expires_at"] is not None
            and int(record["connection_expires_at"]) <= now
        )
    }

    for call_id in expired_ids:
        record = active_calls.get(call_id)
        if record is None:
            continue
        caller_id = str(record["caller_id"])
        target_id = str(record["target_id"])
        if str(record["status"]) == "ringing":
            await _send_terminal_call_event(
                record,
                target_id,
                "call_cancelled",
                caller_id,
            )
        else:
            await _send_terminal_call_event(
                record,
                target_id,
                "hangup",
                caller_id,
            )
            await _send_terminal_call_event(
                record,
                caller_id,
                "hangup",
                target_id,
            )
        release_call(call_id, "timeout")


async def _call_expiry_loop():
    while True:
        try:
            await expire_active_calls()
        except Exception as exc:
            # Never let a transient FCM/WebSocket failure disable expiry for
            # all following calls.
            print("[CN CALL][CALL EXPIRY ERROR]", exc)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)


@app.on_event("startup")
async def start_call_expiry_loop():
    global call_expiry_task
    call_expiry_task = asyncio.create_task(_call_expiry_loop())


@app.on_event("shutdown")
async def stop_call_expiry_loop():
    global call_expiry_task
    if call_expiry_task is not None:
        call_expiry_task.cancel()
        call_expiry_task = None

# ============================================================

def hash_password(password: str, salt: bytes | None = None):
    if salt is None:
        salt = os.urandom(16)

    password_hash = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
        "sha256",
        password.encode("utf-8"),
        salt,
        200_000,
    )

    return (
        password_hash.hex(),
        salt.hex(),
    )


def verify_password(
    password: str,
    password_hash: str,
    password_salt: str,
):
    try:
        salt = bytes.fromhex(password_salt)
    except ValueError:
        return False

    calculated, _ = hash_password(password, salt)

    return hmac.compare_digest(
        calculated,
        password_hash,
    )

def authenticated_user(authorization: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
        return None

    token = authorization[7:].strip()
    return access_tokens.get(token)


def issue_access_token(user_id: str) -> str:
    old_token = user_access_tokens.get(user_id)
    if old_token:
        access_tokens.pop(old_token, None)

    token = uuid.uuid4().hex + uuid.uuid4().hex
    access_tokens[token] = user_id
    user_access_tokens[user_id] = token

    db = get_db()
    db.execute(
        "DELETE FROM access_tokens WHERE user_id = ?",
        (user_id,),
    )
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO access_tokens (token, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
        (token, user_id),
    )
    db.commit()
    db.close()

    return token

@app.post("/login")
async def login(request: LoginRequest):
    user_id = request.user_id.strip()
    password = request.password

    db = get_db()

    user = db.execute(
        """
        SELECT
            user_id,
            username,
            password_hash,
            password_salt
        FROM users
        WHERE user_id = ?
        """,
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchone()

    db.close()

    if user is None:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "ID المستخدم أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة",
        }

    if not verify_password(
        password,
        user["password_hash"],
        user["password_salt"],
    ):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "ID المستخدم أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة",
        }

    token = issue_access_token(user["user_id"])

    old_connection = connections.get(user["user_id"])
    if old_connection is not None:
        try:
            await old_connection.close(code=4001)
        except Exception:
            pass
        if connections.get(user["user_id"]) is old_connection:
            del connections[user["user_id"]]

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": "تم تسجيل الدخول بنجاح",
        "user": {
            "user_id": user["user_id"],
            "username": user["username"],
        },
        "access_token": token,
    }

def send_call_notification(
    target_id: str,
    caller_id: str,
    caller_name: str,
    call_id: str,
    message_type: str = "incoming_call",
):
    token = FCM_TOKENS.get(target_id)

    print("FCM TARGET:", target_id)
    print("FCM TOKEN FOUND:", bool(token))

    if not token:
        db = get_db()
        row = db.execute(
            "SELECT token FROM fcm_tokens WHERE user_id = ?",
            (target_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        db.close()

        if row:
            token = row["token"]
            FCM_TOKENS[target_id] = token

    if not token:
        return

    if not firebase_admin._apps:
        return

    try:
        message = messaging.Message(
            token=token,
            data={
                "type": message_type,
                "call_id": call_id,
                "caller_id": caller_id,
                "caller_name": caller_name,
                "target_id": target_id,
            },
            android=messaging.AndroidConfig(
                priority="high",
                collapse_key=f"call-{call_id}",
                ttl=timedelta(seconds=95),
            ),
        )

        response = messaging.send(message)
        print('FCM SENT:', response)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FCM send error: {e}")

@app.get("/livekit/token")
def livekit_token(
    user_id: str,
    call_id: str,
    authorization: str = Header(None),
):
    if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="missing token")

    token = authorization.replace("Bearer ", "", 1).strip()

    if access_tokens.get(token) != user_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="invalid session")

    # A token must never create or revive a room for an ended/unknown call.
    # Both endpoints can request their own token only while the server owns
    # this exact active call.
    record = active_calls.get(call_id.strip())
    if (
        record is None
        or user_id not in {str(record["caller_id"]), str(record["target_id"])}
        or str(record["status"]) not in {"accepted", "negotiating", "connected"}
    ):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="unknown_or_ended_call")

    livekit_url = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_URL")
    livekit_key = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_KEY")
    livekit_secret = os.getenv("LIVEKIT_API_SECRET")

    if not livekit_url or not livekit_key or not livekit_secret:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="livekit not configured")

    room_name = f"call-{call_id}"

    jwt = (
        api.AccessToken(
            livekit_key,
            livekit_secret,
        )
        .with_identity(user_id)
        .with_grants(
            api.VideoGrants(
                room_join=True,
                room=room_name,
            )
        )
    )

    return {
        "success": True,
        "url": livekit_url,
        "token": jwt.to_jwt(),
        "room": room_name,
    }


@app.websocket("/ws/{user_id}")
async def websocket_endpoint(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    user_id: str,
):
    token = websocket.query_params.get("token", "").strip()
    if access_tokens.get(token) != user_id:
        await websocket.accept()
        await websocket.send_json({
            "type": "session_invalid",
            "reason": "invalid_session",
        })
        await websocket.close(code=1008)
        return

    if user_id in connections:
        # Detach the old socket before awaiting close. Its `finally` handler
        # must not see itself as the active connection and release a call that
        # belongs to the replacement WebSocket.
        old_socket = connections.pop(user_id)
        print("[CN CALL][SOCKET REPLACE] user_id=", user_id)
        try:
            await old_socket.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

    await websocket.accept()

    connections[user_id] = websocket
    print("[CN CALL][SOCKET READY] user_id=", user_id)

    try:
        await websocket.send_json({
            "type": "connected",
            "user_id": user_id,
        })

        while True:
            message = await websocket.receive_json()

            # A replacement connection uses the same token. Ignore anything
            # the closing socket manages to receive after it has been detached
            # so it cannot mutate or release the new connection's call.
            if connections.get(user_id) is not websocket:
                await websocket.close()
                return

            if access_tokens.get(token) != user_id:
                await release_calls_for_user(user_id, token)
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "session_invalid",
                    "reason": "session_revoked",
                })
                await websocket.close(code=1008)
                return

            message_type = str(message.get("type", "")).strip()
            call_id = str(message.get("call_id", "")).strip()
            target_id = str(message.get("target_id", "")).strip()
            print("[CN CALL][CALL MESSAGE] type=", message_type, "call_id=", call_id, "from=", user_id)

            await expire_active_calls()

            if message_type == "call":
                if not call_id:
                    call_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

                if not target_id or target_id == user_id:
                    await websocket.send_json({
                        "type": "call_reject",
                        "call_id": call_id,
                        "target_id": user_id,
                        "reason": "self_call_not_allowed",
                    })
                    continue

                db = get_db()
                existing = db.execute(
                    "SELECT status FROM call_records WHERE call_id = ?",
                    (call_id,),
                ).fetchone()
                db.close()
                target_online = target_id in connections

                if existing is not None:
                    await websocket.send_json({
                        "type": "call_reject",
                        "call_id": call_id,
                        "target_id": user_id,
                        "reason": "duplicate_or_busy",
                    })
                    continue

                # Keep the normal busy protection for calls that are
                # actually in progress. However, an offline target may
                # have a stale FCM ringing call. Replace that stale
                # ringing call instead of forcing the caller to wait
                # for the 90-second ring timeout.
                if target_id in active_call_users:
                    previous_call_id = active_call_users.get(target_id)
                    previous_record = (
                        active_calls.get(previous_call_id)
                        if previous_call_id
                        else None
                    )

                    if (
                        previous_record is not None
                        and previous_record.get("status") == "ringing"
                        and target_id not in connections
                    ):
                        send_call_notification(
                            target_id=target_id,
                            caller_id=str(previous_record["caller_id"]),
                            caller_name=str(
                                previous_record.get(
                                    "caller_name",
                                    "مستخدم CN CALL",
                                )
                            ),
                            call_id=str(previous_record["call_id"]),
                            message_type="call_cancelled",
                        )
                        release_call(previous_call_id, "missed")
                    else:
                        await websocket.send_json({
                            "type": "call_reject",
                            "call_id": call_id,
                            "target_id": user_id,
                            "reason": "duplicate_or_busy",
                        })
                        continue

                if user_id in active_call_users:
                    await websocket.send_json({
                        "type": "call_reject",
                        "call_id": call_id,
                        "target_id": user_id,
                        "reason": "duplicate_or_busy",
                    })
                    continue

                ring_expires_at = message.get("ring_expires_at")
                if not ring_expires_at:
                    ring_expires_at = int(time.time() * 1000) + 90000

                created_at = int(time.time() * 1000)
                status = "ringing"
                db = get_db()
                db.execute(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO call_records
                    (call_id, caller_id, target_id, caller_name,
                     created_at, expires_at, status)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    """,
                    (
                        call_id,
                        user_id,
                        target_id,
                        str(message.get("caller_name", "مستخدم CN CALL")),
                        created_at,
                        ring_expires_at,
                        status,
                    ),
                )
                db.commit()
                db.close()

                active_calls[call_id] = {
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "caller_id": user_id,
                    "target_id": target_id,
                    "status": "ringing",
                    "created_at": created_at,
                    "ring_expires_at": ring_expires_at,
                    "negotiation_expires_at": None,
                    "connection_expires_at": None,
                    "caller_token": token,
                    "target_token": user_access_tokens.get(target_id),
                    "media_ready_users": set(),
                }
                active_call_users[user_id] = call_id
                active_call_users[target_id] = call_id

                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "call_started",
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "target_id": target_id,
                    "from_id": user_id,
                    "ring_expires_at": ring_expires_at,
                    "target_online": target_online,
                })

                if target_online:
                    await connections[target_id].send_json({
                        **message,
                        "call_id": call_id,
                        "ring_expires_at": ring_expires_at,
                        "from_id": user_id,
                    })
                else:
                    send_call_notification(
                        target_id=target_id,
                        caller_id=user_id,
                        caller_name=str(
                            message.get("caller_name", "مستخدم CN CALL")
                        ),
                        call_id=call_id,
                    )
                continue

            record = active_calls.get(call_id)
            if record is None:
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "signaling_rejected",
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "message_type": message_type,
                    "reason": "unknown_or_ended_call",
                })
                continue

            caller_id = str(record["caller_id"])
            receiver_id = str(record["target_id"])
            expected_target = receiver_id if user_id == caller_id else caller_id
            sender_role = (
                "caller" if user_id == caller_id else
                "target" if user_id == receiver_id else None
            )
            expected_token = (
                record["caller_token"] if sender_role == "caller" else
                record["target_token"] if sender_role == "target" else None
            )
            if sender_role is None or expected_token != token:
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "signaling_rejected",
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "message_type": message_type,
                    "reason": "sender_not_call_owner",
                })
                continue

            if target_id != expected_target:
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "signaling_rejected",
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "message_type": message_type,
                    "reason": "invalid_target",
                })
                continue

            status = str(record["status"])
            allowed = False
            next_status = status
            terminal = False
            if message_type == "call_accept":
                allowed = sender_role == "target" and status == "ringing"
                next_status = "accepted"
            elif message_type == "call_reject":
                allowed = sender_role == "target" and status == "ringing"
                next_status = "rejected"
                terminal = True
            elif message_type == "call_cancelled":
                allowed = sender_role == "caller" and status == "ringing"
                next_status = "cancelled"
                terminal = True
            elif message_type == "hangup":
                allowed = status in {"ringing", "accepted", "negotiating", "connected"}
                next_status = "ended"
                terminal = True
            elif message_type == "offer":
                allowed = sender_role == "caller" and status in {
                    "accepted", "negotiating", "connected"
                }
                next_status = "negotiating"
            elif message_type == "answer":
                allowed = sender_role == "target" and status in {
                    "accepted", "negotiating", "connected"
                }
                next_status = "negotiating"
            elif message_type == "ice_candidate":
                allowed = status in {"accepted", "negotiating", "connected"}
            elif message_type == "connected":
                allowed = status in {"accepted", "negotiating"}
                next_status = "connected"
            elif message_type == "timeout":
                allowed = status == "ringing"
                next_status = "timeout"
                terminal = True

            if not allowed:
                await websocket.send_json({
                    "type": "signaling_rejected",
                    "call_id": call_id,
                    "message_type": message_type,
                    "reason": "invalid_state_or_direction",
                })
                continue

            record["status"] = next_status
            if message_type == "call_accept":
                record["negotiation_expires_at"] = (
                    int(time.time() * 1000) + 30000
                )
                print("[CN CALL][CALL_ACCEPT SERVER] call_id=", call_id)
            elif message_type == "offer":
                record["connection_expires_at"] = (
                    int(time.time() * 1000) + 30000
                )
            elif message_type == "connected":
                record["negotiation_expires_at"] = None
                ready_users = record.setdefault("media_ready_users", set())
                if isinstance(ready_users, set):
                    ready_users.add(user_id)
                    if {caller_id, receiver_id}.issubset(ready_users):
                        record["status"] = "connected"
                        record["connection_expires_at"] = None
                    else:
                        # One endpoint has local media, but the call is not
                        # connected until both have reported a usable path.
                        record["status"] = "negotiating"
            forwarded = {
                **message,
                "call_id": call_id,
                "target_id": expected_target,
                "from_id": user_id,
            }
            if terminal:
                await _send_terminal_call_event(
                    record,
                    expected_target,
                    message_type,
                    user_id,
                )
            elif expected_target in connections:
                try:
                    await connections[expected_target].send_json(forwarded)
                except Exception as exc:
                    print("CALL FORWARD WS ERROR:", exc)

            if terminal:
                release_call(call_id, next_status)

    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass

    finally:
        if connections.get(user_id) is websocket:
            del connections[user_id]
            # A network reconnect is not a call hangup.  Keep ownership and
            # let the call's explicit terminal signal or its expiry timer end
            # it; the next socket for this logical user can safely resume.
            print("[CN CALL][SOCKET CLOSED] user_id=", user_id)

## 2. ONE-WAY AUDIO INVESTIGATION

### Media Path Trace

**OUTGOING (Caller):**
```

→ TelecomManager.placeCall()

```

**INCOMING (Callee):**
```
FCM (CallFirebaseService.onMessageReceived)

→ activateTelecomCall() → setActive()
```

### Audio Session Analysis

**Telecom-owned audio (System process):**
- `CallConnectionService.kt:221` — `connection.setAudioModeIsVoip(true)` requests VoIP mode
- Android Telecom (system) calls `AudioManager.setMode(MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION)` → `mModeOwnerPid = system/Telecom`
- Telecom controls routing: `setCommunicationDevice()`, `setSpeakerphoneOn()` (logs confirm)

**LiveKit/FlutterWebRTC-owned audio:**
- `livekit_call.dart:21` — Creates `Room()` with default options (no `AudioSessionOptions`)
- `livekit_call.dart:99` — `participant.setMicrophoneEnabled(true)` → triggers WebRTC audio capture
- FlutterWebRTC (via LiveKit) creates `AudioRecord` (capture) and `AudioTrack(USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION)` (playback)
- `livekit_call.dart:63-66` — Explicitly ignores `setSpeaker()`: "Telecom owns routing"

**NO explicit `requestAudioFocus()` anywhere in Kotlin source.**

### LiveKit 2.11.0 Audio Session Management (Official Docs)

From LiveKit Client SDK documentation:
- `AudioSessionOptions.communication()` — Configures `AUDIO_MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION`, requests audio focus, sets preferred device
- `AudioSessionManagementMode.automatic` (default) — LiveKit manages audio session lifecycle
- `AudioSessionManagementMode.manual` — App manages audio session
- `AudioSessionManagementMode.externalCallSystem` — Telecom/CallKit owns audio session
- `LiveKitClient.initialize(AudioSessionOptions)` — Global init, must be called once per process

**Critical finding:** The current code does **NOT** call `LiveKitClient.initialize()` with any `AudioSessionOptions`. LiveKit uses default `automatic` mode, which assumes it owns the audio session. But Telecom (via `setAudioModeIsVoip`) ALSO owns the audio session. **This is a conflict.**

Previous attempt to add `LiveKitClient.initialize(initialAudioSessionOptions: AudioSessionOptions.communication())` caused total audio loss because it forced LiveKit to request audio focus while Telecom already held it.
